author: jalexis82
quote: GTA 6: The Most Overhyped Simp Simulator Ever? After years of waiting, billions of dollars in hype, and endless promises of a revolutionary gaming experience, GTA 6 looks more like Simp Simulator VI than the next generation of Grand Theft Auto. Instead of delivering the gritty crime, chaos, dark humor, and freedom that made GTA legendary, Rockstar seems determined to sell us a glorified relationship drama with expensive **** trailers look impressive, sure. But pretty graphics don't automatically make a great game. Where's the innovation? Where's the groundbreaking gameplay? So far, the marketing feels like a Hollywood soap opera disguised as an open-world crime **** hype is absolutely ridiculous. People are treating GTA 6 like the second coming of gaming before even proving it deserves that reputation. My verdict based on what we've seen 100% Simp Simulator energy. Rockstar, we wanted Grand Theft Auto, not Grand Theft Attention.
